_how_to_use: Copy this file, rename it (e.g. test_case_2.json, the name must NOT start with _), fill it in. Files starting with _ are ignored. Every .json file in this folder is a test case the bot can pick. Optional: add "start_url": "https://..." to start this case on a different page than bot_settings.json's start_url.
